- [x] The app in production serves the same `ae90a0948`
      (`/api/build-info`, deployment `cd06cbdc`, SUCCESS).
- [x] The feature is dark in production: an unauthenticated POST to
      `/api/internal/product-research/observations` answers **404**, which is
      what the app switch being unset produces. A 401 would mean the route

- [x] The agent service in production held no variables at all. On
      2026-10-08T13:10Z, with the operator's approval, the single build-time

      git before the phase needs it. It turns nothing on: the switch is still
      unset, and the four remaining variables are absent.
- [x] The back-merge to `develop` landed: `bb17277c0` is an ancestor of
      `origin/develop`. The `main is in develop's ancestry` check failed on the

## Known defects released in the dark state

Independent review found four defects in the feature as it stands. They are not
introduced by this release — they are equally present on `develop` and running
on staging — and they are not fixed here. None can act in production while the
switches are unset, because the runner exits at `switch unset` before it spawns
anything.

- [ ] The 15-minute watchdog cannot fire while a child runs: `git` and the
      report run under `spawnSync`, which blocks the event loop, and its timeout
      sends `SIGTERM` and waits. **Affects staging now, during the P1 window.**
- [ ] The submission response is not verified; any 2xx is read as recorded, so
      the `payloadDigest` the route returns for exactly this comparison is never
      compared.
- [ ] The failed-row CHECK omits `developSha IS NULL` / `mainSha IS NULL`, so
      the database does not close the contract the route enforces.
- [ ] The console finds the last success only within the newest 30 rows.
